library(readxl)

```{r}
library(readxl)

bmi_rawdata <- read_excel(here::here("RawData/bmi_rawdata.xlsx"),sheet = 1) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()
bmi_rawdata

```

##==================
## GPT bmi data
##==================

```{r}
gpt_bmi_peak <-
all_data %>% 
  filter(panel_id == "gpt")  %>% 
  left_join(.,bmi_rawdata,
            by = c( "bf_ar_m_nummer" ="edited_bf_ar_m_nummer2")) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
   group_by(bf_ar_m_nummer,obese) %>% 
   filter(labreads == max(labreads, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  
   slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>% 
   filter(!str_detect(attribute, "_From Start|_From start|DBS"))%>% 
   filter(!grepl("SJS_ | Haut_", treatment)) %>% 
  mutate(
    obese = factor(obese,levels = c("yes","no")),
    labreads = as.numeric(labreads)
  )

gpt_bmi_peak
  
```
```{r}
str(gpt_bmi_peak$labreads)
```


```{r}
library(dlookr)

gpt_bmi_peak %>% 
  normality(labreads)
```

```{r}
t.test(
   labreads ~ obese,
  data = gpt_bmi_peak
)
```

```{r}
library(ggstatsplot)

ggbetweenstats(
  data = gpt_bmi_peak,
  x = "obese",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",
  title = "all groups_Comparsion of obesity vs. peak-labreads", # ALT for labvalue and daily dose",
       xlab = "obesity",
       ylab = "peak-ALT u/l") 

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(svglite)

# Patient counts
n_patients <- gpt_bmi_peak %>%
  distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer, obese) %>%
  count(obese, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("N = ", n),
    y_pos = max(gpt_bmi_peak$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  )

# Pure ggplot2 version
all_groups_alt_obese_non_obese_patients_peak <- 
  ggplot(gpt_bmi_peak,
         aes(x = obese,
             y = labreads,
             fill = obese)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.15,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = obese, y = y_pos, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format",
    label.y = max(gpt_bmi_peak$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "All Groups: Comparison of peak-ALT for obese vs. non-obese patients",
    x = "Obesity",
    y = "Peak-ALT(U/L)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12,
                              face = "bold", colour = "red"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )

all_groups_alt_obese_non_obese_patients_peak


dir.create(here::here("output/plots_peak"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("output/plots_peak/alt_peak_all_groups_violin_plot_obese_non_obese_patients.svg"),
  plot = all_groups_alt_obese_non_obese_patients_peak,
  device = "svg",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# PNG
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("output/plots_peak/alt_peak_all_groups_violin_plot_obese_non_obese_patients.png"),
  plot = all_groups_alt_obese_non_obese_patients_peak,
  width = 4,
  height = 2,
  dpi = 600
)
```


```{r}

o1_diclo <- gpt_bmi_peak %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Leber_Diclo")
o1_diclo_counts <- o1_diclo %>% 
  group_by(obese) %>%
  summarize(n_patients = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`), .groups = "drop")
o1_diclo <- gpt_bmi_peak %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Leber_Diclo") %>% 
  ggplot(aes( x =obese, y = labreads))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(colour = "red")+
  geom_text(data = o1_diclo_counts, 
            aes(x = obese, 
                y = max(gpt_bmi_peak$labreads) * 0.4, 
                label = paste0("n=", n_patients)),color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "obesity",
    y = "peak-ALT U/L",
    title = "Leber_Diclo" )+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust =0.5)
  )
```

```{r}
got_bmi_peak <- left_join(got_full, bmi_rawdata, c = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2") %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
group_by(obese) %>%  group_by(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`) %>%   filter(labreads == max(labreads, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
#  filter(!attribute == "got Day_Unknown") %>% 
 filter(!str_detect(attribute, "_From Start|_From start|DBS"))%>% 
 filter(!grepl("SJS_ | Haut_", Treatment))  
got_bmi_peak
```

)

```{r}

ggbetweenstats(

  x = "obese",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",

       xlab = "obesity",
       ylab = "peak-got u/l") 

```


```{r}
# Schritt 1: Anzahl einzigartiger Patienten pro Diabetes-Gruppe berechnen
n_patients <- got_bmi_peak %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, obese) %>%  # nur einzigartige Patienten
  count(obese, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = got_bmi_peak,
  x = "obese",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "All Groups: Comparison of peak-got for obese vs. non-obese patients",
  xlab = "obesity",
  ylab = "peak-got u/l",
  messages = FALSE
)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots einfügen
all_groups_got_obese_non_obese_patients_peak <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = obese, 
        y = max(got_bmi_peak$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )

dir.create("plots_peak", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_peak/got_peak_all groups_violin plot_obese non obese patients.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(all_groups_got_obese_non_obese_patients_peak)
dev.off()

  group_by(obese) %>%
  summarize(n_patients = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`), .groups = "drop")
o3_para <- inr_bmi_peak %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Leber_Para") %>% 
  ggplot(aes( x =obese, y = labreads))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(colour = "red")+
  geom_text(data = o3_para_counts, 
            aes(x = obese, 
                y = max(inr_bmi_peak$labreads) * 0.8, 
                label = paste0("n=", n_patients)),color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "obesity",
    y = "peak-inr ",
    title = "Leber_Para" )+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust =0.5)
  )
```
